site.title: The Unfinished Story
site.description: The autobiography of Ravi Raj Singh — a living document.

author.name: Ravi Raj Singh
author.bio: Writer based in Patna, India. Author of 'A Boy Who Never Thought' — an autobiography in progress.

book.title: A Boy Who Never Thought
book.subtitle: Safar Se Safar Tak

epigraph.text: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.

dedication: To Mummy — who chose R over N.
To Papa — who came running from the field.
To Dadi — who I never got to know.
And to the boy who never thought.
book.preface: You can read this book in order. Or not. Some chapters will hurt. Some will comfort. Some will do both. Take your time. This story is still being written.

journal.startContext: After 12th exams, in the result waiting phase.

current.reading: The Remains of the Day — Kazuo Ishiguro
